newsitem.title: USA: CHS expects Q1 EPS in excess of $0.40.
newsitem.headline: CHS expects Q1 EPS in excess of $0.40.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings for the first quarter to be in excess of $0.40 per share and revenues to exceed $900 million.
It said it does not forsee any extraordinary income or charges for the first quarter.

The company also said it purchased three privately held micro-computer distribution companies with combined 1996 revenue of $201 million, and signed a letter of intent to buy Lars Krull A.S., which had 1996 revenue of $70 million and is based in Alborg, Denmark.
CHS reported 1996 first quarter earnings of $0.25 per share on revenues of $303 million.
The acquired companies are International High Tech Marketing Inc of Miami; Dinexim, the trade name for Dinoral Corp of Miami; and Acces and Agora s.r.o. of Brno, The Czech Republic.
The company said it is forcasting combined 1997 revenue for the four companies of $375 million.
The companies were acquired for CHS shares and cash to be paid after earn-out periods of one and two years.
The company said it expects the purchases to be accretive.
